specificationName: Database Schema Initialization - Automatic Schema Creation on Fresh Deployment

components.currentBehavior: Set to false - schema initialization hook is completely disabled
components.desiredBehavior: Set to true - schema initialization should run automatically after SurrealDB deployment
components.gap: Need to fix namespace/database configuration mismatch before re-enabling

components.currentBehavior: Job is defined but never runs because initSchema.enabled=false. When enabled, job fails with BackoffLimitExceeded due to namespace/database mismatch
components.desiredBehavior: Job should run as post-install/post-upgrade hook and successfully create all required tables with PERMISSIONS FULL
components.gap: Environment variables SURREAL_NAMESPACE and SURREAL_DATABASE must match what SurrealDB server actually uses

components.currentBehavior: Starts SurrealDB with 'memory' storage mode, no namespace/database specified in args
components.desiredBehavior: Should explicitly set namespace/database that matches init-schema Job expectations

components.currentBehavior: Starts SurrealDB with RocksDB storage, no namespace/database specified in args
components.desiredBehavior: Should explicitly set namespace/database that matches init-schema Job expectations

components.currentBehavior: Defines database.namespace=metabob and database.name=production in values, but these are not passed to SurrealDB server
components.desiredBehavior: These values should be used by both SurrealDB server and init-schema Job
components.gap: Values exist but not applied to server startup args

components.currentBehavior: Python script that creates 13 tables with PERMISSIONS FULL and 8 indexes. Connects using SURREAL_NAMESPACE and SURREAL_DATABASE env vars
components.desiredBehavior: Script is correct - it should work once namespace/database configuration is fixed
components.gap: No gap in script itself - the issue is in configuration

dataFlow: helmfile apply → SurrealDB starts (missing ns/db args) → init-schema SKIPPED (disabled) → RPC API starts → implicit schema creation → UNKNOWN STATE ⚠️
traceImpulseId: trace-Database Schema Initialization - Automatic Schema Creation on Fresh Deployment
rootCause: Namespace/Database configuration mismatch between SurrealDB server startup and init-schema Job

fixStrategy.step1: Add --ns and --db args to SurrealDB deployment.yaml and statefulset.yaml
fixStrategy.step3: Test fresh deployment with helmfile destroy && apply
fixStrategy.step4: Verify Job completion and schema creation via kubectl logs

impact.deploymentsAffected: All fresh deployments have unknown schema state
